quote: Under the soft shimmer of crystal chandeliers and starlit waters, two souls unite in timeless elegance and everlasting devotion.

invocations.universal: Together with their noble families, Julian & Genevieve cordially request the honour of your presence at the solemnisation of their holy matrimony.

venue.name: Château De La Belle Vue & Grand Lakeside Pavilion
venue.address: Route Du Lac Royal, French Riviera Estate, 74290 Talloires, France

dressCode.title: Regency Elegance & French Black-Tie
dressCode.description: Ladies are graciously requested to wear soft powder blues, pearl ivory gowns, or floral couture. Gentlemen in black-tie or deep French blue evening tailcoats.

events.name: The Royal Welcome Soirée & High Tea
events.description: An afternoon of artisanal French macarons, vintage champagne fountains, live harp serenade, and gentle lakeside waltzes.

events.name: The Candlelight Sangeet & Musical Gala
events.description: An enchanted evening of celestial classical harmonies, choreographies under shimmering crystal chandeliers, and imperial banqueting.

events.name: The Grand Procession & Solemn Matrimony
events.description: The sacred vows exchanged amidst cascades of powder-blue hydrangeas, string quartets, and golden twilight lake reflections.

events.name: The Imperial Ball & Waterfront Banquet
events.description: Michelin-curated five-course banquet, grand midnight waltz under starlight fireworks, and celebration by the moonlit lake.
